dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Continuous reduction in the lateral width of the 2D profile from the maximum breadth at the mid-section toward the visible posterior termination.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white median pixel intensity with minimal grayscale variance across the primary dorsal area.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: High-density dark-pixel cluster exhibiting a localized, grid-like geometric texture on the posterior right dorsal quadrant.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Sharp, distinct gradient boundaries between the depigmented mature white skin and the dark-toned textured region on the right flank.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: High-contrast circular blowhole aperture at the anterior dorsal position; scattered low-contrast dark specks on the mid-right dorsal surface.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Central longitudinal shadow line indicating the dorsal ridge structure extending through the posterior half of the visible body.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent, dark, textured epidermal patch on the right posterior flank with a distinct cross-hatched or repetitive geometric pattern.
